It means the actual shaft diameter is between:\n\n- Maximum: 12.000 mm\n- Minimum: 11.973 mm\n\nSo the shaft can be up to 0.027mm smaller than 12.000mm, never larger.\n\n### What this means for your bearings\n\n6001-2RS bearings have a 12mm ID (inner diameter). The bearing's inner race is typically 12.000 +0/-0.008 mm. With an h8 shaft:\n\n**Worst-case gap:** 12.000 (bearing ID) - 11.973 (shaft) = **0.027mm clearance**\n\n**Best case:** essentially zero clearance\n\nThis is a **slip fit** \u2014 exactly what you want. The shaft slides into the bearing with hand pressure, no hammer needed, and rotates freely without wobble.\n\n**h7 vs h8:** h7 is tighter (up to 0.018mm smaller), h8 is slightly looser (up to 0.027mm smaller). For your application both work. h8 is actually easier to assemble \u2014 you will not need to press-fit the bearings.\n\n### Bottom line\n\n**h8 is the right choice.** This is the standard for:\n- 3D printer linear rails\n- DIY CNC machines\n- Hobby robotics\n- Exactly the application you have\n\nIf you had a precision industrial application needing \u00b10.005mm repeatability you would want h6 or h7. A -0.05mm \"press fit\" in reality means:\n- Best case: tight press (acceptable)\n- Common case: cracks around the pocket as bearing wedges in\n- Worst case: print comes out +0.1mm oversized and bearing falls out\n\n**Your fix is correct:** +0.02 to +0.05mm clearance, secured with Loctite 603 retaining compound. This is the professional approach.\n\n**Change:** `PRESS_FIT = +0.05` (slip fit), add Loctite 603 to assembly BOM.\n\n### Issue 2: No axial retention \u2192 **YOU ARE RIGHT**\n\n**Agree 100%.** The bearing can slide axially in the pocket. M5 countersunk screws have an 82\u00b0 or 90\u00b0 cone under the head. If the bore is cylindrical, the screw head sits on a ring instead of seated fully, which:\n- Reduces holding strength by 50%+\n- Puts stress concentration at the screw neck\n- Screws stick up above the surface, interfering with plate mounting\n\n**Your fix is correct:** Use `Part.makeCone(r1, r2, height)` or similar.\n\nFor M5 countersunk head screws (DIN 7991):\n- Head diameter: ~10mm\n- Head height: ~2.8mm\n- Cone angle: 90\u00b0\n\nCorrect geometry: cone from \u00d85.5mm (shank bore) to \u00d810mm (head flush) over 2.8mm height.\n\n### Issue 6: No belt load consideration \u2192 **PARTIALLY AGREE**\n\nI calculated the actual load and want to share the numbers:\n\n| Source | Load |\n|---|---|\n| Belt tension | 126 N |\n| Cassette weight | ~10 N |\n| Dynamic start/stop shock | ~20 N |\n| **Peak radial load** | **~156 N (35 lbf)** |\n\nMy flex analysis shows the 70x70x30mm block deflects about **9 microns** under peak load - essentially negligible. Total: $24.</div>\n\n  <h3 style=\"color:#7e22ce;\">Item 1: Loctite 603 Retaining Compound</h3>\n  <div class=\"product-card recommended\">\n    <div class=\"prod-title\">Loctite 603 Threadlocker Oil-Tolerant Retaining Compound 10ml</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Why this:</strong> The V2 design uses slip-fit bearings (0.05mm clearance) locked into place with Loctite 603. This is a high-strength retaining compound specifically designed for bearing installation on metal and plastic. Shear strength ~17 N/mm^2 after 24h cure. One 10ml bottle is enough for the entire project (each bearing uses ~0.2ml).</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Amazon product:</strong> <span class=\"asin-code\">B000HBGVEY</span></div>\n    <div class=\"prod-link\"><a href=\"https://www.amazon.com/dp/B000HBGVEY\">https://www.amazon.com/dp/B000HBGVEY</a></div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Search fallback:</strong> Amazon search \"Loctite 603 10ml\" or \"Loctite 603 retaining compound\"</div>\n    <span class=\"price-tag\">$15-20</span>\n    <div class=\"recommendation\">TIP: If Loctite 603 unavailable, Loctite 609 or Permatex 640 retaining compounds are equivalent. Avoid regular threadlockers (242/262) - those are for threads, not bearing retention.</div>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 style=\"color:#7e22ce; margin-top:25px;\">Item 2: Steel Thrust Washers</h3>\n  <div class=\"product-card recommended\">\n    <div class=\"prod-title\">Steel Thrust Washer 12mm ID x 26mm OD x 1.5mm thick (pack of 10 or more)</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Why this:</strong> The 51101 thrust bearing must NOT rest directly on PETG - plastic will creep and deform under axial load. Steel washers above and below the thrust bearing distribute the load properly. Need 2 washers minimum, pack of 10 is cheap insurance.</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Amazon product recommendation:</strong> <span class=\"asin-code\">B07P4L7NBD</span> or similar</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-link\"><a href=\"https://www.amazon.com/s?k=thrust+washer+12mm+26mm\">Search: thrust washer 12mm 26mm</a></div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Search terms to use on Amazon:</strong> \"thrust washer 12mm 26mm 1.5mm\" or \"flat washer 12mm ID 26mm OD hardened steel\"</div>\n    <div class=\"prod-details\"><strong>Required specs:</strong> ID exactly 12mm (shaft passes through), OD 26mm to match 51101 outer, thickness 1-2mm, material hardened carbon steel or stainless steel (NOT aluminum).</div>\n    <span class=\"price-tag\">$5-8</span>\n    <div class=\"recommendation\">TIP: McMaster-Carr part 92141A031 (12mm x 26mm x 1.5mm) is the professional option at ~$3 each. Amazon packs are cheaper for quantity.</div>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"alert alert-v2\" style=\"margin-top:20px;\">\n    <div>\n      <strong>Why both items are essential:</strong> Without Loctite 603, bearings will gradually rotate in their PETG pockets and create noise/wobble. Without thrust washers, the steel 51101 bearing will sink into the PETG over time (thermoplastic creep). Both failures take weeks to appear but are expensive to fix once assembled. Total cost $24 vs. reprinting the bearing housing later - an easy decision.\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<!-- ==================================================================== -->\n<div class=\"section\">\n  <h2>Section B - Already Ordered (41 items, $888.80)</h2>\n  <div class=\"section-desc\">Full list of purchased items with verification status.
